messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up — ACME legal just sent back their security questionnaire and a list of POC must-haves for BYO-HSM + Redwood Private. Main asks: dual-custodian key ceremony, ability to rotate keys on a 7-day cadence, scheduled blackout windows, and explicit replication SLA for HA HSM clusters. Also asking for a one-time integration fee + ongoing HSM handshake billing.

sam_solutions: Got it. Important to clarify: are they expecting Redwood to import their keys, or do they want us to reference keys that remain in their HSM (BYOK reference)?

nina_sales: They want keys to stay in their HSM and Redwood to call into it for signing/encryption ops. No key export. They mentioned KMIP or PKCS#11 gateway as options.

ethan_eng: Technical note: we support KMIP over TLS and have a PKCS#11 proxy pattern for on-prem HSMs. Key points:
- latency will increase (we measured ~8-40ms per signing op depending on network)
- throughput limits depend on customer's HSM TPS; we can autoscale Redwood workers but HSM is the bottleneck
- rotation scheduling + blackout windows are doable but require orchestration hooks from customer's side (rotation handshake API or a maintenance endpoint)

mika_security: Security checklist from questionnaire: need HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3 cert + firmware version), key custody model doc, and proof we never export wrapped keys outside customer boundary. Also they want key rotation policy proof and a runbook for emergency key-recovery.

sam_solutions: For pricing, they asked for: 1) one-time integration SOW (engineering + ops), 2) recurring per-HSM connection fee, and 3) per-op premium for calls that proxy to BYO-HSM. Any rough numbers to feed them?

ethan_eng: Rough ballpark: integration SOW ~ 2-3 engineer-weeks (scoped: network tunnel, KMIP testing, auth config, failover test). Ops runbook + oncall onboarding ~ 1 week. Recurring connector fee suggestion: $1500–3000/mo depending on HA requirements. Per-op premium: add 10–25% over standard hosted per-token price to cover latency/ops. I'll refine after looking at their expected TPS.

mika_security: We'll need to sign an addendum around audit logs and provide SOC2 + evidence of KMS access controls. Also request their security team to fill the "HSM connectivity checklist" — items: allowed IPs, cert chain, KMIP vendor, FIPS cert, maintenance windows.

nina_sales: Customer pushed back on the recurring connector fee. Counter ask: can we offer a monthly credit for the first 3 months if they commit to a 12-month Dedicated contract?

ethan_eng: That's a commercial decision, but we can absorb onboarding cost if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity (Dedicated) — reduces churn risk. For technical risk, we need a signed test plan:
```
- export: none
- auth: mTLS to KMIP endpoint (client certs)
- perf test window: 2 days, 10k ops/day
- failure mode: local fallback -> Redwood-hosted key variant (if customer approves)
```

sam_solutions: Two enterprise blockers noted by legal: 1) UK data residency — they want the KMIP proxy deployed in eu-west-2, 2) indemnity language around key compromise during network transit.

mika_security: For transit indemnity we can add standard network controls and require customer to run gateway in their network. We can't accept unlimited indemnity; propose a clause limiting liability to the SOW cap. Also we can provide TLS+HSM attestation artifacts for added assurance.

jon_ops_bot: ACTION created: sales-1234 BYO-HSM POC — draft SOW + security checklist -> assignees: @sam_solutions, @mika_security, due 3 business days.

nina_sales: Thanks. Sam — can you draft the SOW estimate and itemize the integration tasks + costs? Mika — can you draft the security checklist to send to ACME? I'll negotiate the 3-month credit.

sam_solutions: On it. I'll post a short SOW draft here in ~24h. Need ACME expected TPS and target latency SLA to finalize per-op premium.

mika_security: I'll attach the HSM attestation template and checklist to the thread when ready. Quick ask: do we have a precedent SOW for the FinCo BYO-HSM work last year I can reuse?

ethan_eng: I have a sanitized copy of the FinCo SOW and perf results — ping me and I'll drop it in the private drive (contains vendor specifics).

nina_sales: Great, thanks all. If anyone hears urgency from ACME (legal/infosec), tag me.

sam_solutions: FYI — ACME asked for a pre-POC connectivity test window next week. I'll coordinate test credentials once SOW draft is approved.

mika_security: Noted. We'll need the customer's KMIP endpoint + test cert + allowed IPs at least 48h before the window.

nina_sales: Closing—keeping this thread for SOW + security checklist drafts.
